name: gptscope
description: Clean-room inspector for authorized ChatGPT Desktop harness evidence

scripts.tauri:dev: npm run ui:build && npm run tauri:icons && tauri dev --config apps/tauri/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
scripts.tauri:win: npm run ui:build && npm run tauri:icons && tauri build --config apps/tauri/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis,msi
scripts.tauri:mac: npm run ui:build && npm run tauri:icons && tauri build --config apps/tauri/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles dmg,app
